name: OpenThinker3-7B
notes: Not a new architecture: config.json carries _name_or_path = .../Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and the repo's base_model tag is Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Qwen2ForCausalLM, hidden 3584, 28 layers, 28 query heads / 4 KV heads - identical serving shape to Bespoke-Stratos-7B and OpenR1-Qwen-7B, which is the point: the OpenThoughts/Open-R1/Bespoke ecosystem is a large family of interchangeable weight files on one architecture. Trained on dataset open-thoughts/OpenThoughts3-1.2M. max_position_embeddings 32768, half the 131072 of the DeepSeek R1 Qwen distills of the same size. head_dim derived as 3584 / 28 = 128; gqa_ratio = 7. use_cache is false in config (trainer default). KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 28 layers x 4 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 57344 B/token = 56.0 KiB/token. At its native 32k context that is 1.75 GiB of KV per sequence at bf16. context_scaling is null: context length is native to the pretrained config, no rope_scaling.
